faqs.q: My puppy is shy, or missed early socialisation. Will class help, or is it too late?
faqs.a: It depends on your puppy's age. A young puppy can simply come along to class as normal. Once a puppy is around six months or older, ring Gaynor first for a chat about how your puppy is getting on, so she can judge the best way in. If your puppy turns six months partway through a course you are already on, just keep going. There's no need to stop.
